correctness.rationale: Exact exhaustive enumeration of all 4096 vertex subsets under two independent predicates; 324 faces and 105 facets; two acyclic Morse matchings on all 323 nonempty faces with 972 covering incidences checked, leaving critical (0,2,3) ranks (1,2,22); exact signed Morse 2-by-22 boundary matrices each have determinant-one minor. Two 2-cells cancel topologically in the simply connected Morse CW complex, leaving twenty 3-spheres. Full simplicial mod-2 and mod-3 ranks (11,55,85) corroborate without substituting for the integral proof. Standalone verifier and output are embedded.

value.rationale: The first positive forest stage / two-independence complex of the highly symmetric regular icosahedron is a canonical natural invariant outside known graph-family formulas. A complete integral homotopy classification distinguishes this complex from nearby independence, matching, cut and neighborhood constructions, and provides an exact reproducible benchmark. The 20 summands coincide numerically with the 20 triangular faces but no canonical equivariant interpretation is asserted.
